handbook.birdwatch.heron.name: Little Egret
handbook.birdwatch.heron.habitat: Habits: Forages slowly along shallow shorelines and mudflats, elegant yet alert; active by day, roosts in trees or reeds at dusk, flies off when startled.
handbook.birdwatch.heron.tip: Tip: Ambush riverside shallows while sneaking; alarm distance is about 8 blocks. Use a 200mm+ tele lens from 20m away; focus on the eye and keep shutter at 1/500s or faster to freeze the wingbeat.
